name: Quantization MFU Asymmetry
author: human
driftDescription: INT8 quantization is asymmetrically efficient — attention layers benefit but FFN layers lose throughput, producing sustained MFU drop with rising HBM pressure and subtle quality regression.

name: Quantization Outlier Token Inflation
author: human
driftDescription: INT8 quantization error on high-magnitude weight outliers causes the model to generate systematically longer outputs — token count and cost rise together with corpus delta and slight MFU erosion, mimicking valid workload growth.

name: Quantization Long-Tail Regression
author: human
driftDescription: INT4 quantization errors manifest only on tail token distributions — corpus delta is flat during the early bake window then accelerates sharply as long-tail prompts accumulate, with gradual MFU degradation testing late-onset behavioral detection.

name: Quantization Layer Sensitivity
author: human
driftDescription: INT8 quantization-sensitive transformer layers cause HBM pressure and corpus delta to co-rise while MFU erodes and latency creeps — multi-metric slowbleed pattern that avoids crossing any single-signal threshold cleanly.

name: p99 rises while TTFT drops (broken latency correlation)
author: human
driftDescription: p99 rises and ttft drops — both within individual ratio thresholds but breaks the native positive (p99, ttft) correlation. Hotelling T² spikes on the anti-correlated direction.

name: MFU drops + cost rises (broken utilization correlation)
author: human
driftDescription: mfu drops and cost rises over 32 ticks — normally util-loaded factor makes these co-move; anti-correlated drift breaks that pattern.

name: KV rises + HBM drops (unusual inverse memory pattern)
author: human
driftDescription: kv_cache rises while hbm_spill drops — inverse of the typical memory-pressure pattern. Individually small; multivariate test picks up the inversion.

name: Cross-family covariance-break (p99 up, ttft down, cost up, mfu up)
author: human
driftDescription: Multi-signal drift that breaks two native correlations simultaneously: (p99, ttft) anti-correlated and (mfu, cost) anti-correlated. Family A misses each signal; Family C catches the joint pattern.

name: Slow-burn anti-correlated multi-signal drift
author: human
driftDescription: 4-signal anti-correlated drift with late onset at tick 6 — 26 ticks of anti-correlation give Hotelling T² enough accumulation to cross the χ² boundary while each individual signal stays under its δ_min.

name: W4 KV Cache Oscillation
author: agent
driftDescription: kv_cache oscillates 8% at period 6 ticks (cache-bounce from partial eviction cycling). Amplitude kept small so Family C Mahalanobis stays sub-threshold and Family A CUSUM doesn't accumulate (mean stationary); Family D ACF picks up the periodic signature.

name: W4 Latency Bounce
author: agent
driftDescription: p99 and ttft bounce 14% at period 5 ticks (retry-storm latency flapping). Mean-stationary drift evades slope detectors; Family D catches the periodic signature.

name: W4 HBM Pressure Oscillation
author: agent
driftDescription: hbm_spill oscillates 22% at period 7 — periodic memory pressure from a batch-scheduling anomaly. Zero net drift trips no slope detector; Family D ACF catches the frequency signature.

name: W4 High-Dimensional Subtle Drift
author: human
driftDescription: 8 signals drift coherently at sub-per-signal-threshold magnitudes. Joint Mahalanobis distance lands in the extreme tail of the baseline's nonconformity distribution — Family E novelty territory. Family C may catch via anti-correlation; Family E targets the cross-dimensional novelty even when covariance-consistent.

name: W4 Tail Shape Shift
author: agent
driftDescription: Uncommon multi-signal pattern: corpus_delta rises, kv_cache drops, collective_ops degrades slightly, mfu rises. Not on any Family-C-correlated pair axis; joint pattern novel relative to baseline.

name: W4 Marginal Distribution Novelty
author: human
driftDescription: Tokens/turn rises while corpus_delta also rises — uncommon pairing in baseline (roughly independent there). Coupled with subtle hbm/kv movement, joint pattern is novel; Family E captures via conformal p-value on Mahalanobis distance.
